# GrowthBook AI for 5.2
Date: 2026-09-16 | Duration: 35.779998779296875m

## Summary
The team discussed an AI-driven experimentation workflow that guides experiment setup, flags missing guardrails, validates launches, monitors metrics, and recommends ramp-up or cleanup actions. Slack is the intended primary interface for proactive alerts, experiment queries, approvals, and pauses, although the team must balance flexible AI responses with structured, low-noise interactions. Smart notifications, event coalescing, text-based digests, concise templates, and interactive buttons were identified as priorities. Technical work includes a large pull request supporting streaming and chat AI, new APIs for experiment changes and deeper data queries, event-payload integration for AI calls, and a Langfuse event-source integration for testing AI metrics. The team also discussed whether to use scheduled AI agents or built-in monitoring, while positioning Growthbook as an experimentation-focused complement to enterprise automation tools. Near-term priorities include Slack digests, experiment analysis, infrastructure support, technical-debt reduction, and preparation of AI capabilities for the 5.2 release.

## Keywords
AI-driven experiments, Slack integration, smart notifications, experiment digest, Langfuse integration, event coalescing

## Action Items

**Ashley Stirrup**
Present AI-driven experiment management mockup and gather further feedback for 5.2 release (01:01)
Advocate user guidance features for next steps in experiment lifecycle within the product or Slack (18:46)

**Luke Sonnet**
Review Slack integration PRs focusing on digests and smart notifications; decide on text-based digest format for usability (27:34)
Collaborate with Adriel to finalize and polish Slack experiment digest feature and add capabilities for event payload AI annotations (31:04)
Prioritize infrastructure and API improvements to support smart notifications and agent-assisted deep dives into experiment results (31:04)

**Graham McNicoll**
Continue refinement of in-chat AI features adapting from web focus to streaming data for GrowthBook Slack integration (09:30)
Initiate Langfuse integration for AI observability and experimentation support; reach out to Langfuse contacts for collaboration (32:07)
Assist in enabling Slack buttons and event coalescing features for richer AI-driven interaction (19:24)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Develop smart notification logic focused on filtering noise and grouping events to improve Slack app usability (13:59)
Implement Slack digest using text format with hyperlinks that allows better mobile and desktop user experience (28:10)
Collaborate on better AI judgment integration for assessing experiment anomalies and generating actionable reports (07:55)
